jobs.description:
Our tax team of six, led by our Head of Tax, covers the tax matters of all group companies worldwide. To support us in Berlin or Karlsruhe, we are looking for a Tax Specialist (f/m/d)  who wants to work across the full range of our tax topics and is keen to build expertise in transfer pricing.

Tasks

- Preparing tax balance sheets and tax returns for the German group companies together with our colleagues.
- Support in preparing and maintaining our transfer pricing documentation (Master File, Local Files, CbCR), including functional and risk analyses.
- Contributing to the implementation and further development of intercompany transfer pricing guidelines and models and reviewing intercompany agreements in coordination with the business functions.
- Tax assessment of business transactions, contracts and restructurings.
- Advising business functions and subsidiaries on tax matters, and acting as contact person for our foreign entities on operational questions regarding the operational application of transfer pricing requirements.
- Supporting tax audits and communicating with tax authorities and external advisors.
- Helping us develop our Tax Compliance Management System further and digitalise our tax processes.
- Monitoring legislative changes and case law, and deriving recommendations for action.

Qualifications

- Academic track record with a finance and international tax background.
- At least three years of professional experience in tax consultancy, audit, or an in-house tax function; experience in the tax department of a multinational group is an advantage.
- German Tax Advisor Exam is an advantage.
- Sound knowledge of German corporate income tax law; knowledge of international tax law is desirable.
- Initial exposure to transfer pricing, or a clear interest in building expertise in this area.
- Experience with SAP and common tax software, along with very good Excel skills.
- Structured and independent way of working, and enjoyment of working with different business functions.
- Business-fluent German and good English language skills.

Benefits

- Hybrid working model.
- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.
- Modern office space with very good transport connections.
- Various employee discounts for activities and products.
- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
- Numerous training and development opportunities.
- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.description:

Remote Sensing Specialists; Data Scientists; Physicists

Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  

Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  

Target Group: Remote Sensing Specialists, Data Scientists, Physicists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  

About Project IRIS Project IRIS develops AI-supported spatial resilience and geospatial data models for the energy transition. To breathe dynamic life into our static infrastructure data, we integrate global earth observation data into our central inference engine. In this role, you will add the dimension of real-time surface activity and physical states to our spatial intelligence models. 

Your Focus & Responsibilities 

- Satellite Pipelines: Build automated pipelines to fetch and process Sentinel-1 (Radar/InSAR) and Sentinel-2 (Multispectral) data via the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. 
- Algorithm Development: Develop algorithms to automatically detect surface changes, vegetation decline, moisture indices (NDVI/NDWI), and thermal anomalies. 
- Data Integration: Seamlessly integrate derived raster metadata and Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COG) into our central PostGIS vector database. 

What We Are Looking For 

- Technical Background: Degree in Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Data Science, Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  
- Core Technical Skills: Deep practical experience in processing satellite data (Landsat, Sentinel) using Python libraries such as Rasterio, xarray, or GDAL. 
- Mindset: An analytical mindset capable of deriving tangible ecological, thermal, and structural factors from raw pixel values. 
- Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  
- Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  

What We Offer 

- Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.

- Modern Tech Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment focused on cutting-edge geospatial intelligence.

jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security - ManageEngine, ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have long years of experience ( 5 + ) with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.- You have 3-5 years of experience with ManageEngine or similar technologies.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).

jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.Tesla is accelerating the transition to sustainable energy with our industry-leading Residential Energy Products, including Powerwall, Wall Connector, Solar, and the full Residential Energy Ecosystem. These products are already deployed in over 40 countries, with fleets growing exponentially as more partners include them in their projects and installations.The Residential Systems Diagnostics Team uses critical thinking and deep product knowledge to deliver best-in-class, engineer-level support for Tesla’s residential storage and home charging products. As an Associate Systems Diagnostics Engineer, you’ll troubleshoot medium-to-high complexity technical issues, support internal engineering and field teams, and go deep on proprietary power electronics and energy systems. You thrive on challenging edge cases, balance detailed problem-solving with big-picture thinking, and excel in fast-paced, collaborative environments.This role is available in Amsterdam and Berlin.

What You’ll Do

- Own and resolve technical cases from internal engineering, technical, and field service teams via ticketing, email, and live chat
- Troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems, metering, communications, and supporting components
- Use CLI tools (Linux, SSH, SCP, VI) to connect to devices, pull logs, and edit configurations
- Read and interpret single-line diagrams for PV, storage, load, and meter configurations
- Handle VIP and corporate white-glove escalations with urgency and precision
- Partner with engineering teams on root cause analysis (RCA) and emerging issue tracking (JIRA)
- Document cases thoroughly and identify process or knowledge gaps to improve training and resources
- Deliver internal and external upskilling/training sessions

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or 3+ years in a Technical Support Engineering role
- Strong understanding of electrical theory, AC/DC power systems, metering, energy flow, power factor, and phase rotation
- Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues involving multiple variables (metering, communications, distributed generation/storage preferred)
- Proficiency with Linux command line (SSH, SCP, VI) and comfort learning proprietary systems quickly
- Experience with SQL, Python, or AI tools is beneficial
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills – able to explain complex technical topics clearly
- Strong case management discipline: prioritization, detailed documentation, and follow-up
- Experience with CRM tools and MS Office
- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus
- Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with engineering and cross-functional teams
- Genuine curiosity for energy products and willingness to go deep on new technology

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

At Lexxion we are proud to serve as a specialist publisher for all stakeholders within the European Union. Based in Berlin, we offer legal journals, books, conferences and professional training in areas such as European data protection law, State aid, defence, and artificial intelligence law.

We are looking for a full-time Executive Editor (m/f/d) to join our editorial team, starting 1 January 2027. This is a 1-year fixed-term position to provide maternity cover. The Editor will be in charge of Lexxion’s portfolio of publications in the fields of AI law, data protection law and food law.

Tasks

- Management of legal journals: desk reviews, editing, formatting and typesetting of manuscripts; liaising with authors, reviewers and editorial team; planning content, setting and adhering to production deadlines.
- Keeping abreast of developments in relevant legal and policy areas; pro-actively curating the journals to reflect interesting developments in the focus areas.
- Creating and implementing outreach and business development initiatives to increase the visibility of the journals (in conjunction with Lexxion's marketing team).
- Developing ideas for and supporting the planning of trainings and conferences with our conference managers.

Requirements

- Strong interest in European and international law and policy.
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in EU law/affairs, international law/affairs or related fields.
- 1+ years of prior professional experience.
- Excellent planning, management and interpersonal skills.
- Comfortable interacting with high-level professionals and experts.
- Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail coupled with strategic, big-picture thinking.
- A background in the specific journal topics is an advantage, but not a requirement.
- Previous experience in the publishing sector will be highly valued.Excellent written and spoken English (native speaker or equivalent). Some German language skills would be helpful for everyday exchange with colleagues, but are not a must

Benefits

- Opportunity to expand your network and editorial experience, working closely with leading experts from various domains in a dynamic, internationally focused publishing house.
- Supportive professional environment with a flat hierarchy which fosters self-initiative and provides the freedom to transform ideas into reality.
- Regular EU-wide business travel and attendance of leading events in relevant fields.
- 1-year fixed-term contract for maternity cover, starting 1 January 2027, alongside a competitive salary commensurate with the applicant’s experience and qualifications.
- The position is based in Berlin, Germany.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. Introduction Chat (30 min; via telephone or MS Teams)
Objective: Both parties gain a first impression, discuss the company, the position, and the team; share your experience, interest in and qualification for the position; address questions about the role and the company.
2. Test Assignment (1 hour; remote; unpaid)
Objective: Demonstrate your ability to do a task that will be part of your work as Executive Editor.
3. Test Assignment Q&A, Line Manager and CEO Interview (1.5 hours; in person at Lexxion’s office in Berlin-Wilmersdorf)
Objective: Give and receive feedback on your test assignment; discuss your qualifications, motivation, professional goals and fit with the company culture; talk in more depth about the position, the immediate and extended team you will be collaborating with; explore your management and interpersonal skills; discuss salary and onboarding process; possibly meet some relevant Lexxion employees.
4. Offer Talk
Objective: Present our offer; agree on start date; discuss the onboarding process.

Location
Güntzelstraße 63, Berlin (Berlin), Germany
